question: OMERS foriegn curency exposure 2025 and impact on retrun
answer:
**OMERS – foreign currency exposure, 2025**

Two reported variants of the exposure table (both for OMERS, at December 31, 2025):

MD&A currency exposure table:
- Canadian Dollar: $81,621 million (55% of portfolio) [source: omers-2025.pdf (OMERS), text - page 30]
- United States Dollar: $51,427 million (35%) [source: omers-2025.pdf (OMERS), text - page 30]

- Total: $147,116 million (100%) [source: omers-2025.pdf (OMERS), text - page 30]

Headline exposure: "At December 31, 2025, 45% of our net investment exposure was exposed to foreign currencies, compared to 54% at the end of 2024. This decrease in foreign currency exposure resulted primarily from a strategic decision to increase our hedge positions in early 2025." [source: omers-2025.pdf (OMERS), text - page 30]

Financial statements variant (net investment assets by currency exposure, after the impact of currency hedging):
- Total Foreign Currency Exposure: $65,608 million (44%) [source: omers-2025.pdf (OMERS), text - page 83]
